'''DX-2K2''' was an ancient [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]] used by [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] agent [[Govin Thane]] in his attempt to stop a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="Cloud Cover" />
